entry.title: Ebony wood x Celestial Blade (Butt only)
entry.summary:
Vendor: Cues Master Shop
Type:
Price: 42000.00

Inspired by the elegance of a legendary sword, the Celestial Blade is a handcrafted ebony cue butt that embodies precision, artistry, and timeless design. A meticulously handcrafted abalone sword inlay shimmers under the light, beautifully contrasted by the rich black ebony and clean white ringwork for a striking, sophisticated look.

Designed for discerning players and collectors, the Celestial Blade showcases exceptional craftsmanship and premium materials. Whether matched with your favorite shaft for play or displayed as part of a collection, this cue is a true statement of style and performance.

Specifications

  • Weight: 17 oz
  • Butt Length: 29.5"
  • Pin: Radial
  • Wood: Premium Ebony wood
  • Inlay: Handcrafted Abalone Sword design
  • Configuration: Butt Only (Shaft Not Included)

Where craftsmanship meets legendary design. ⚔️🎱
